title: Future Traveler
text:
the future traveler, haxs official mascot, traveled to bring our ideas life. he moves through time, taking best of every era and carrying them into future, where data flows like water. is a variant rpg-character, itself caricature hax's creator. on-model when has red helmet with hax visor band, steampunk goggles, lightbulb on stalk green backpack. variants change style setting, never those features. filter grid below by role.

text:
a 30-second neon title sequence. credits tell the hax story from napkin in 2015 to hundreds of courses while red letters drift by, then lock into / web mark. play, pause, scrub, or read every credit as text.

title: Use the art
text:
attribution hax (haxtheweb), https://github.com/haxtheweb/art
license
the proposal is cc by 4.0 for art created; see licensing.md. the interactive homages credit what inspired them on their own pages. a few future traveler variants riff closely other creators characters or brands; those aren't shown here and are flagged in manifest.json review before promotion.
hotlinking
every image this site raw github url, such as https://raw.githubusercontent.com/haxtheweb/art/main/world-traveler/funny-traveler-15.png. file names repo never renamed, so these links stay stable.
how was made
most ai-generated remixes of original human-made character. pieces (rpg glitch, web game, web, wanted poster, under minute, opening titles episode xxvi) were made with an ai assistant (claude) team direction. hax's writing brand marks not ai-generated.
add to collection
open pull request haxtheweb/art; agents.md has rules. refresh after adding variants, run node tools/hax-art-items.mjs import result cli.
